rules.statement: An XML doc comment, or an instruction file describing a member, must state only what the member actually does, such as exactly which values a builder method copies and which come from separate properties.
rules.why: Readers who trust docs that overstate behavior expect values that aren't there, and tests that rely on that can pass or fail for the wrong reason.
rules.check: For added or changed summaries and convention bullets, compare each claim about what a method copies, sets or returns against its body, and report claims the code doesn't fulfil.

rules.statement: Don't ask a test-data builder to copy a collection it receives through an init property into an immutable collection when its build method already copies that collection into each built object: the rule on buffering stored collections is for long-lived production state.
rules.why: Each built object is already independent of the caller's collection, and until the build method runs a test-data builder is meant to reflect its inputs; a builder lives for one test statement.
rules.check: Before reporting a stored caller collection in a test builder or test-support type, check whether the build method copies it into a new collection; if it does, don't report it.
